trajectory_summary: This is a warm inbound callback that stayed warm throughout — customer self-motivated toward cost info, minor frictions (utility mismatch, credit privacy, tech capability) were each resolved in one beat, and the call closed with a booked date and time. Energy built steadily rather than being tested by real resistance; the rep's main job was staying out of the way and adapting quickly, which he did.
